name: data-list-pager
title: Data List Pager
description: A controlled paging footer for DataList — a tabular-numeral range summary, a rows-per-page Select, and a windowed Pagination that hides on a single page.

meta.whenToUse: Paging a DataList (or any host-paged list): the range, rows-per-page, and page controls in its footer slot, with page state owned by the host.
meta.whenNotToUse: Keyset or cursor paging with no total (LoadMore, or DataList's and DataGrid's loadMore), or bare page links with no page-size choice (Pagination).
